shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated vertical strokes / register of upright elements
band of triangles or zigzag beneath a horizontal line
row of repeated schematic units across the upper portion
curved-top slab-shaped surface with registers arranged one above another
elongated linear object with a hooked/curved end (staff or hook motif)
justification: Both surfaces are rounded-top slabs organised into stacked horizontal registers, and both share a strikingly specific sequence: a row of repeated upright rectangular/columnar units above a horizontal line, immediately beneath which runs a band of downward-pointing triangles or zigzags, with a long curved-ended object crossing the field. The biggest difference is that A additionally carries large recognisable animals in profile (quadrupeds, a long-necked bird, a snake-like form) filling the lower field, whereas B is entirely abstract/geometric with no creatures at all.
